Webhook Signature Verifier

Verify HMAC-SHA256 webhook signatures (GitHub, Stripe-style) with SubtleCrypto — paste payload, secret and signature.

–
Verdict

Computed locally with SubtleCrypto — your secret never leaves the browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste the exact raw request payload.
  2. Enter the webhook secret.
  3. Paste the signature from the request header and pick its format.
  4. Click Verify to get a valid/invalid verdict.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which signature formats are supported?

Raw hex, base64, "sha256=" prefixed hex (GitHub) and Stripe-style "t=…,v1=…" headers — the v1 value is extracted automatically.

Why does verification fail on a real payload?

The payload must be byte-identical to what was signed — even one changed whitespace or encoding difference breaks HMAC.

Is my secret sent anywhere?

No — HMAC is computed locally with SubtleCrypto. Nothing leaves your browser.

Which algorithm is used?

HMAC-SHA256, which is what GitHub, Stripe and most providers sign with.
